## 维护者速读

- 专题由 5 号座位的专区 `ux-37424` 接手（Bill 2026-11-26T05:27Z 「开一个专区处理专题 37424」）。
- 先做了 fable 四轴评估，结论是方向对、改几处再拆。Bill 定了：名字保留「应用搭建 / App Studio」，不改叫本体；分五个阶段，第一阶段先做主框架和左侧菜单；顶栏按钮按推荐安置（2026-11-26T05:57Z 「按推荐启动」）。
- 第一阶段已立 6 张子卡（见下表），其余阶段先只是表里的行，滚动拆卡。
- 还要你答的 5 个问题在下面，各自到对应阶段之前答即可，都不挡第一阶段。

## Phase table

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Shell and menu | #37451 ADR-0084 / 0146 amendment, written once for all phases (Tier H) | — | ux-37424, contract-tier card thread |
| 1 Shell and menu | #37452 Menu styled as the front end + graphite tokens | — | ux-37424 |
| 1 Shell and menu | #37454 Thin package overview (概览 first entry, Info + Pending tabs, ⋯ moved) | #37451, #37383 | ux-37424 |
| 1 Shell and menu | #37455 Top-bar tenants rehomed (Save/Cancel, AI, slot toggle) + graphite on root | #37451, #37383 | ux-37424 |

| 4 Org-level content | #37453 Investigation: loose-item counts, package-less writers, ADR-0150 addressing | — | ux-37424 |
| 2 List and overview | row: list page (decision 7; can start early, no file overlap) | — | not filed |
| 2 List and overview | row: full overview (history tab, action layout, `.custom` pairing, landing after disable/delete) | phase 1; question 1 | not filed |
| 2 List and overview | row: Setup → Packages slimmed + wording (tasks 8 + 12), folding #37401 (its #37400 premise is stale) | full overview; question 1 | not filed |
| 3 Tiers, moves, naming | rows: dataset domain `ui → data` (L2); tier table; `~all` + Diagnostics to Setup; naming display text (governed skills text) | #37451; questions 4, 5 | not filed |
| 4 Org-level content | rows: package-less create asks (UI + kernel close, L2); loose-item clean-up and `~org` retired | #37453; questions 2, 3 | not filed |
| 5 Close | row: walkthrough, e2e, platform checklist, docs and skills — re-parent #36910 here | phases 1–4 | not filed |

## Corrections to this body (verified on origin/main 7d50dc8b)

- The top bar has more tenants than Publish: Save/Cancel, the AI button and the right-slot toggle. Their homes are ruled (#37451 quotes them). The real critical path is 1-0 → 1-3/1-4 → 1-5, not 1 → 3.
- #37368 is merged; #37383 (seat 4, draft) is still the blocker for every shell card that edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. #37452 and #37453 do not touch it.
- The package-less kernel backstop is not closed (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-scope.ts` still offers a package-less save), so task 9 cannot be UI-only.
- Most of decision 11 is already ruled by ADR-0070 D3/D5/D6, and the adopt door already ships; the decision card shrinks to questions 2 and 3 below.
- The product label today is "Studio", not "App Studio" (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts:32`).

## Open questions for the maintainer (each asked before its phase; none blocks phase 1)

1. Disable / enable / delete: stay in Setup with a "manage in Setup" link from the overview (recommended; keeps the 2026-10-30 ruling on #28117), or move to Studio as decision 1 says. Before phase 2.
2. Close package-less creates in the kernel, with named exemptions from #37453 (recommended), or UI-only. Before phase 4.
3. Loose items: one-shot migration plus the existing bulk adopt, then retire `~org` (recommended), or the per-item sorting page. Before phase 4.
4. Record `dataset` and `position` in the common tier as named placements (recommended). Before phase 3.
5. `~all` goes to an access-related Setup group, not Diagnostics (recommended). Before phase 3.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

## 维护者速读

- 问题 2、3 已裁（Bill 在专区线程回「同意」）：内核收口无包新建只豁免四类；散落项原地保留，新做一个按选择移进软件包的入口，旧的一次全收接口和 `~org` 入口退役。
- 这两件都是第四阶段，现在不立卡；第四阶段开始时按下面的裁决拆卡。

## Ruling record

Ruled (2026-11-26T06:45Z): the maintainer answered 「同意」 in the area thread at 2026-11-26T06:44Z to the area's message proposing "2、3 按推荐", whose recommendations were (analysis by a contract-tier agent, `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat5/topic-37424/q2-q3-analysis.md`; readings from #37453 comment 7184476778):

- **Question 2 — A.** When the kernel closes package-less creates (ADR-0070 D1), only four writers keep a named exemption: kernel-item overlays until the platform-pair whitelist (W3), the ruled external-datasource import (W4, server-stamped `writeFace: 'external-import'`), binding-preserving migrations (W12) and platform registration (W13). Everything else closes, `os meta register` included (it takes `--package` like every author door). The UI ask (create with no package asks to pick or create one) and the kernel close ship in the same phase, the kernel PR last, no flag. Sibling rulings carried with it: in-place saves of existing loose rows stay open; organization-authored sharing rules, queues and assignment rules in Setup bind to the owning object's `.custom` package, with no new exemption (their write path is to be traced when the card is cut).
- **Question 3 — C.** Existing loose items stay where they are (ADR-0150 D1 bucket 4: environment-authored rows belong to the implicit environment package, no rename, no migration). One new "move into package" door takes a selection (one, several or all) and runs each item through the save door's judges, judging the selection as a set for the ADR-0150 D3 (a) cross-boundary rule; it reuses the existing list page. `adopt-orphans` and the Studio `~org` entry retire at once when it ships. This supersedes the parent's per-item sorting page (task 10) and the earlier one-shot-migration recommendation.
- #37468's three defects close with that door (each a regression test); `reassignOrphanedMetadata` is not patched.

Questions 1, 4 and 5 stay open. The #36890 leftovers (re-parent #36910, detach #37359, close #36890, #37401 into phase 2, #35513 into phase 1) await the maintainer's answer on the area's decision card.
